access_links.label: Clean Investment Monitor database and reports

description: The Clean Investment Monitor tracks investments in the manufacture and deployment of clean energy and decarbonisation technologies, with facility-level data on manufacturing plants and deployment projects, plus analysis of policy effects and federal spending estimates for the United States. It is produced by Rhodium Group and the MIT Center for Energy and Environmental Policy Research (CEEPR), with contributions from Bruegel. Coverage is global, with dedicated sections for the United States, including state and congressional district breakdowns, and China; the database is updated quarterly with reports on the latest trends. It is explored free through the website; the page read does not describe data downloads or a licence. Caveats: announced projects may be delayed or cancelled, and investment values rely on company announcements and the producers' estimates. For simulation it shows where new battery, solar and other clean technology factories are being built, useful for capacity planning of the power, water and transport infrastructure that must serve them, and for mapping emerging manufacturing supply chains. It is related to the Critical Minerals Atlas record in this catalogue, which maps the upstream mineral sites.
